metrics.label: Bookings
metrics.definition: OpenTable reservations for that dining date (Brisbane time), excluding cancelled.

metrics.label: Booked covers
metrics.definition: Guests seated from OpenTable bookings that day.

metrics.label: Walk-in covers
metrics.definition: Walk-in guests seated through OpenTable's host stand that day (only if the team records walk-ins there).

metrics.label: No-shows
metrics.definition: Bookings for that day marked no-show in OpenTable.

metrics.label: No-show rate
metrics.definition: No-shows divided by bookings, from the totals for the period.

metrics.label: Website bookings
metrics.definition: OpenTable bookings for that day made through the booking widget on the venue's website.

metrics.label: Share of bookings from the website
metrics.definition: Website bookings divided by all bookings.

metrics.label: Sales (Lightspeed)
metrics.definition: Lightspeed sales that trading day, ex GST, including walk-ins and bar-only sales.

metrics.label: Spend per cover (blended)
metrics.definition: Lightspeed sales divided by all covers. Blended: bar-only sales with no table are included.

metrics.label: Website visits
metrics.definition: GA4 sessions on the website that day.

metrics.label: Website visits that booked
metrics.definition: Website bookings divided by website visits.
